changes_made.explanation: No changes needed. All extracted metadata is correct and properly normalized. Keyphrase extraction is a text summarization task and the paper explicitly evaluates on NLG.
Simplified all F1 variants (F1@5, F1@10, F1@15) to base form 'F1' according to normalization rules. The paper only uses F1 score at different cutoffs, not different metrics.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is conducted in this paper. The paper uses pre-trained language models (T5, BART) for keyphrase extraction, not for post-generation evaluation.
No human evaluation is mentioned in the paper. The evaluation is entirely automated using F1 scores against gold standard keyphrases.

overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. The paper focuses on unsupervised keyphrase extraction using prompt-based methods with encoder-decoder models. Evaluation is purely automatic using F1 scores at different cutoffs. No human or LLM-as-judge evaluation is conducted. All metadata was properly extracted and only required minor normalization for metrics.
